lyrics.original: 빤히 날 또 바라볼 텐데
lyrics.english: You'll be staring at me again

lyrics.original: 괜히 눈을 감고 그려보게 돼
lyrics.english: For no reason, I close my eyes and imagine it

lyrics.original: 멈추지 않을 Melodies, 선명히 번진 Memories
lyrics.romanization: meomchuji aneul melodies, seonmyeonghi beonjin memories
lyrics.english: Melodies that will never stop, Memories spreading vividly

lyrics.original: 소중하게 담아둘래
lyrics.english: I'll keep them close to my heart

lyrics.original: All the time 떠올리면 웃게 돼
lyrics.romanization: all the time tteoollimyeon utge dwae
lyrics.english: Whenever I think of them, I smile all the time

lyrics.original: 네 하루 맨 뒷장의 맘이, 무거운 숨을 삼킬 때
lyrics.romanization: ne haru maen dwitjangui mami, mugeoun sumeul samkil ttae
lyrics.english: When the feelings on the last page of your day, Swallow a heavy sigh

lyrics.original: 구겨진 밤 나의 위로, 네 작은 두 손에 전해지게
lyrics.romanization: gugyeojin bam naui wiro, ne jageun du sone jeonhaejige
lyrics.english: May my comfort on a crumpled night, Reach your little hands

lyrics.original: We go on and on and on, 베개 맡에, 깊은 꿈을 둘게
lyrics.romanization: we go on and on and on, begae mate, gipeun kkumeul dulge
lyrics.english: We go on and on and on, By your pillow, I'll leave a deep dream

lyrics.original: Like a dream, 함께 헤매일, 시간의 길가에
lyrics.romanization: like a dream, hamkke hemaeil, siganui gilgae
lyrics.english: Like a dream, Wandering together, Along the roads of time

lyrics.original: 춤추듯 발을 맞추는, 너와 나
lyrics.english: Matching our steps as if we're dancing, You and I

lyrics.original: 둘만 아는 Passage, 그 안에 새겨둔 Message
lyrics.romanization: dulman aneun passage, geu ane saegyeodun message
lyrics.english: A passage only we know, A message engraved inside it

lyrics.original: 네 두 눈 위로 내린 소원들이, 가만히 널 비춰 주길
lyrics.romanization: ne du nun wiro naerin sowondeuri, gamanhi neol bichwo jugil
lyrics.english: May the wishes falling over your eyes, Quietly shine upon you

lyrics.original: 어느새 서로를 닮은, 너와 나
lyrics.english: Before we know it, we've come to resemble each other, You and I

lyrics.original: 어디로든 가자 다 괜찮아, 당연한 듯 같은 걸 바라봐
lyrics.romanization: eodirodeun gaja da gwaenchana, dangyeonhan deut gateun geol barabwa
lyrics.english: Let's go anywhere, it's all okay, We naturally wish for the same things

lyrics.original: 네 손을 잡고 다시 걸어보면 마치
lyrics.romanization: ne soneul japgo dasi georeobomyeon machi
lyrics.english: When I hold your hand and start walking again, it's like

lyrics.original: 왈츠처럼 넌 자꾸 날 이끄는 걸
lyrics.romanization: walcheucheoreom neon jakku nal ikkeuneun geol
lyrics.english: You keep leading me like a waltz

lyrics.original: 지친 맘이, 내 긴 밤이, 아팠던 하루 끝이, 벅차 때론
lyrics.romanization: jichin mami, nae gin bami, apatdeon haru kkeuchi, beokcha ttaeron
lyrics.english: My tired heart, my long night, The end of a painful day, Sometimes it's overwhelming

lyrics.original: But I was never alone alone, 겁날 게 없어, 네가 있을 테니까
lyrics.romanization: but i was never alone alone, geomnal ge eopseo, nega isseul tenikka
lyrics.english: But I was never alone alone, There's nothing to be afraid of, Because you'll be there

lyrics.original: 잠에 들면, 같은 꿈을 꿔 매일 With you
lyrics.romanization: jame deulmyeon, gateun kkumeul kkwo maeil with you
lyrics.english: When I fall asleep, I dream the same dream every day with you

lyrics.original: 항상 바라, 널 수놓은 내일에
lyrics.english: I always look forward, To the tomorrows I've embroidered with you

lyrics.original: We go on and on and on, 오랜 꿈에, 너를 데려갈게
lyrics.romanization: we go on and on and on, oraen kkume, neoreul deryeogalge
lyrics.english: We go on and on and on, Into an old dream, I'll take you with me

lyrics.original: Like a dream, 함께 헤매일, 시간의 길가에
lyrics.romanization: like a dream, hamkke hemaeil, siganui gilgae
lyrics.english: Like a dream, Wandering together, Along the roads of time

lyrics.original: 춤추듯 발을 맞추는, 너와 나
lyrics.english: Matching our steps as if we're dancing, You and I

lyrics.original: 둘만 아는 Passage, 그 안에 새겨둔 Message
lyrics.romanization: dulman aneun passage, geu ane saegyeodun message
lyrics.english: A passage only we know, A message engraved inside it

lyrics.original: 네 두 눈 위로 내린 소원들이, 가만히 널 비춰 주길
lyrics.romanization: ne du nun wiro naerin sowondeuri, gamanhi neol bichwo jugil
lyrics.english: May the wishes falling over your eyes, Quietly shine upon you

lyrics.original: 어느새 서로를 닮은, 너와 나
lyrics.english: Before we know it, we've come to resemble each other, You and I

lyrics.original: 너의 맘의 파동, 그 박에 맞게 Step on
lyrics.romanization: neoui mamui padong, geu bage matge step on
lyrics.english: The waves of your heart, Step on, matching their rhythm

lyrics.original: 손을 놓지 않을 테니, 그저 날 바라만 봐
lyrics.romanization: soneul nochi aneul teni, geujeo nal baraman bwa
lyrics.english: I won't let go of your hand, Just keep looking at me

lyrics.original: 수없이 내 꿈에 온 너, 날아드는 Butterflies
lyrics.romanization: sueopsi nae kkume on neo, naradeuneun butterflies
lyrics.english: You, who came into my dreams countless times, Butterflies flying toward me

lyrics.original: 매번 널 알아볼게
lyrics.english: I'll recognize you every time

lyrics.original: (맘이)
lyrics.english: (Heart)

lyrics.original: (잠에)
lyrics.english: (When I)

lyrics.original: (들면)
lyrics.english: (Fall asleep)

lyrics.original: (항상)
lyrics.english: (Always)

lyrics.original: (바라)
lyrics.english: (Look forward)

lyrics.original: (데려갈게)
lyrics.english: (Will take you)

lyrics.original: (너와 너와 나)
lyrics.english: (You and you and I)
